title: Indian-origin siblings turn lemonade stand into nonprofit, donating books and helping 15,000 students
summary_full: Rohan and Anya Satija initiated the Let's Learn Foundation to provide books and mental health support. They began their efforts with a lemonade stand in 2018, raising awareness about educational inequalities. The foundation has since reached over 15,000 students across Texas and partnered with various organizations for resources. Their mission continues to focus on underserved communities to ensure equitable access to education.
